## Code

```cpp
class Solution {
public:
    int maxFrequency(vector<int>& nums, int k) {
        sort(nums.begin(), nums.end());

        int left=0;
        long long sum=0;

        int ans=1;

        for(int right=0; right<nums.size(); right++){
            sum+=nums[right];
            int cost= nums[right]*(right-left+1)-sum;

            while(cost>k){
                sum-=nums[left];
                left++;
                cost=nums[right]*(right-left+1)-sum;
            }

            ans=max(ans, right-left+1);


        }
return ans;

    }
};
```
